summary: Frontend-focused iteration for the new /dubai-vize-ucreti fee page + trust/legal cross-page components. All requested checks passed: new page renders end-to-end (data-testid='visa-fees-page'), 4 fee groups + 7 fee rows with TRY/USD amounts that match GET /api/visa-types, hero starts with 'Yetişkin vizeleri 5.190 ₺ ... kişi başı tutardan başlar' (adult, not child, cheapest), all supporting sections render (fee-family-discount, fee-express-block with express + instant_express addons, fee-extras-block with insurance/eSIM/tour cross-sells whose 'from' prices match cheapest matching /api/products entries, fee-excluded, fee-factors, payment-trust-strip, BankAccounts, fee-refund-summary + fee-refund-link -> /iade-kosullari, fee-faq-accordion with 7 questions, content-byline). Meta title/description/canonical correct, script#jsonld-visa-fees-faq is valid FAQPage JSON with 7 questions. Sitemap served from backend (status 200, XML), 32 dubaivizehatti.com occurrences, 0 dubaivizeonline.com occurrences, contains /dubai-vize-ucreti; robots.txt Sitemap line points to https://dubaivizehatti.com/sitemap.xml. Header 'Vize Ücretleri' link (desktop) + mobile menu sheet entry both wired to /dubai-vize-ucreti. Footer has data-testid='footer-fees-link' (href=/dubai-vize-ucreti) and data-testid='footer-disclaimer' starting with 'Yetkili özel seyahat acentesiyiz'. No 'Belge No: 0000' anywhere. Apply button /basvuru?vize=visa_60_multi correctly navigates and preselects '60 Günlük Çok Girişli Dubai Vizesi' (14.810 ₺) in step 1. /vize-tipleri, /gerekli-belgeler, /sss, /dubai-vizesi/30-gun-tek-giris all render content-byline (and /vize-tipleri also renders payment-trust-strip). No console/page errors on any page. Insurance nowhere claimed mandatory; FAQ answer says 'zorunlu tutulmaz ... şiddetle öneriyoruz'. No SMS promise on fee page. Mobile 390px: Kalış/İşlem süresi columns are display:none as designed. Backend spot checks: GET /api/content/site company.tursab_no/tax_no/mersis_no/trade_registry_no are all empty strings (no '0000' placeholders); agency_info.items only contains Ticaret Unvanı / Acente Türü / Adres (no Vergi Dairesi placeholder row). GET /api/visa-types returns 7 types with prices that match what the fee page renders.
critical_code_review_comments: VisaFees.jsx grouping puts child visas into groups.child correctly, but the row description under child rows reuses v.popular flag (visa_30_child is marked popular=true from seed) so the child row shows '· en çok tercih edilen' – harmless but slightly misleading in a child-visa context; consider suppressing the 'popular' badge for category==='child'.

The 'insurance mandatory' text scan flags true because the FAQ intentionally uses 'zorunlu tutulmaz'/'zorunlu değil'. This is copy-correct; no action needed, but future automated checks should look for negations before flagging.
Fee page CTA at bottom (fee-cta-apply) links to /basvuru without a vize= param – acceptable because per-row Başvur buttons already handle preselect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 104 verified the new /dubai-vize-ucreti fee page and cross-page trust/byline components introduced in 'Paket 1 – Güven & Fiyat'. All data-testid selectors listed in the review request exist and behave as specified. Sitemap/robots.txt are served with the dubaivizehatti.com domain. Backend legal-id placeholders in /api/content/site are empty strings. If iterating on this area, prices come from GET /api/visa-types with live FX (fx_rate ~49.38 during this run) so avoid hardcoding TRY totals in tests – compare vs API response like this suite does.
